    t1.supplyflowstate AS current_supply_flow_state
FROM
    operations AS t1
JOIN
    distributionhubs AS t2 ON t1.opshubref = t2.hubregistry
WHERE
    t1.resourceallocstate ILIKE '%critical%'
ORDER BY
    t1.opsregistry;

SELECT
    t1.opsregistry AS registry_id,
    t2.storecapm3 AS storage_details,
    t2.storeavailm3 AS storage_details,
    t1.supplyflowstate AS current_supply_flow_state
FROM
    operations AS t1
JOIN
    distributionhubs AS t2 ON t1.opshubref = t2.hubregistry
WHERE
    t1.resourceallocstate = 'Critical'
ORDER BY
    t1.opsregistry;
